newsitem.title: USA: USDA to donate farm goods to Kyrgyzstan, Tajikstan.
newsitem.headline: USDA to donate farm goods to Kyrgyzstan, Tajikstan.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Wednesday said it would donate U.S. farm goods to the private charity Mercy Corps International (MCI) to distribute to the needy in Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan.

USDA said it would donate about 4,000 tonnes of rice and vegetable oil to Kyrgyzstan, including 1,000 tonnes of vegetable oil the charity may sell to raise money for small business enterprise initiatives and rural credit projects.
It said it was donating about 2,500 tonnes of rice and vegetable oil to Tajikistan, of which MCI may sell 150 tonnes to fund small business initiatives and rural credit projects.
The supply period for the donations is fiscal year 1996. Both donations were made under USDA's Food for Peace Program.
